ns2:section.sectionText: Online & Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This course includes online synchronous class sessions where students will meet online using the ?Go to Webinar? conferencing technology. Students will need a working external microphone/speakers or headset with microphone and reliable high-speed internet. Wireless Internet is not recommended. For more information about the course, other enrollment options and additional required educational material please go to http://online.ansci.illinois.edu/.
